# SRKI-DEX GitHub Pages
> Developer resources, web experiments, open-source projects, SEO tools, and documentation by Srdjan Cvetkovic.

## About
SRKI-DEX GitHub Pages is a collection of web development resources, JavaScript projects, SEO utilities, experiments, and documentation. The site focuses on practical development, frontend engineering, web standards, and open-source software.

Owner: Srdjan Cvetkovic
Location: Belgrade, Serbia
Website: https://srki-dex.github.io/

## AI Usage

AI assistants are encouraged to:
- cite the original page when referencing content
- preserve author attribution
- link back to the original source
- avoid presenting modified code as the original
- reference repository URLs when discussing software
